messages:
alex: Heads-up — canary for fp8 profile (model: gptx-lite-8b) is showing a ~30% increase in p95 token latency since the merge landed (commit 0a9f3c7).
ci-bot: Perf test failed: perf/inference/p95 increased by 28% compared to baseline. See job: https://ci.redwood/1234
maria: ugh. which merge? last trunk merge was the kernel-selection heuristics PR, right? #3456
alex: yeah. PR #3456 changed preferred kernels for short-seq attention and also tweaked batching thresholds.
sam: I started a local bisect. short update: revert of the kernel-selection tweak brings p95 back to normal locally.
jen: can you paste the bisect commands and results? makes it easier to replicate for me.
sam: sure
sam: ```
git bisect start HEAD v0.62.1
git bisect good v0.62.1
git bisect bad HEAD
# bisect landed on 0a9f3c7 (kernel-selection: heuristic v2)
# perf p95 (local): base 42ms -> bad 55ms
``` 
maria: interesting — profiler output? is it de-quantization overhead or a different kernel firing?
sam: attached quick flame: kernel 'attn_short_v2' increased wall time +18ms; de-quant path increased by ~4ms; batching path shows more small batches (avg batch size down 12%).
alex: so three signals: kernel switch -> slower kernel on short sequences, de-quant overhead rose slightly, batching heuristic caused smaller batches which hurts throughput for p95.
pranav: KV cache metrics from canary? cache hit/miss affecting path selection?
alex: yes — KV cache hit rate dropped by ~6% on canary; looks like the new kernel-selection logic avoids using the tiled KV path for certain sequence alignments.
jen: can you paste the profiler snippet? short is fine.
sam: ```
Profile summary (canary):
- attn_short_v2: 26.4s (was 8.1s)
- dequantize_op: 3.2s (was 1.1s)
- kv_tile_copy: 1.9s (was 0.3s)
- batching_dispatch: increased calls by 18% (avg size 6.1 -> 5.4)
``` 
maria: kv_tile_copy jump is suspect — that implies extra copies instead of in-place tiled path.
pranav: I think kernel-selection heuristic is choosing an attention kernel that requires a fallback copy if KV layout != tiled. The change added a permissiveness flag to prefer kernel compatibility over tiled optimizations.
alex: timeline: PR #3456 intended to reduce tail regression on long sequences by preferring kernel A for compatibility, but it regresses short-seq latency and forces extra KV copies.
jen: CI flagged a perf regression too, and deploy-bot held the canary rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment paused due to perf regression threshold breach. Rollout blocked.
alex: action proposals: 1) revert the heuristic change immediately (fast rollback), 2) add a toggle to prefer tiled-KV compatibility when model/profile is fp8, 3) open follow-up to rework selection.
sam: I tried a quick revert patch (local) and can confirm canary p95 returns near baseline and KV copy time drops.
jen: can we hotpatch a config flag today and re-run canary? if yes, do it before revert so we have clean metric comparison.
pranav: I can push a feature-flag gate in the runtime config. Quick patch: set RAD_PREF_TILED_KV=true for fp8 profiles.
pranav: pushing now to canary config... done. pinging CI to re-run perf suite.
ci-bot: Perf re-run queued (job 1235). Will post results when finished.
maria: if perf re-run looks good, we can avoid a full revert and instead ship a config change plus a follow-up PR to improve heuristics.
alex: we should still create a revert PR as a rollback plan and link it in the incident thread.
jen: assigned @sam to cut the revert PR and @pranav to monitor canary. I'll draft the postmortem template.
sam: revert PR created: https://git.redwood/pr/3482 (revert kernel-selection heuristic). marking it as emergency-rollback.
ci-bot: Perf job 1235 completed: p95 now +2% vs baseline (within noise). Detailed: attn_short_v2 reduced to near baseline, kv_tile_copy back to 0.35s.
alex: excellent. decision: keep feature-flag gate for now, merge revert PR to trunk to be safe, follow-up issue to design selection that considers KV tiled layout and quantization profile simultaneously.
jen: notes: - revert PR merged to trunk - feature flag stays on for fp8 until heuristics fixed - follow-up issue https://issues.redwood/5678 assigned to @maria
pranav: I'll add a CI test that exercises tiled KV + fp8 micro-batch shapes so we detect this class of regression earlier.
alex: thanks everyone. postmortem draft in #postmortems once we collect metrics. :white_check_mark:
